plain: Trying everything reasonable to bring out a model's full ability before concluding it cannot do something.
eli5: Giving the dog every chance and every treat before deciding it really cannot fetch.
technical: Measuring a model's capability ceiling rather than its default behaviour, using fine-tuning, scaffolding, tools, prompt engineering and best-of-n sampling; a negative result only shows that elicitation failed, so dangerous-capability results are upper bounds on safety.
